updates.tweet_text: Hard to overestimate the importance of specialization day trading. My watchlist has 1 price on it: ES, I look at nothing else. In ES, I trade one setup that I've workshopped & drilled 10s of thousands of times. You won't beat the algo's being a jack of all trades, master of none
updates.notes: Pure trading philosophy commentary. No prices, no levels, no actionable content whatsoever.
